parameters.jsCode:
const s = $json;

const valid =
  /^MILO-[0-9]{3}$/.test(s.storyId ?? '') &&
  s.scriptId === `${s.storyId}-S01` &&
  s.outlineId === `${s.storyId}-O01` &&
  /^MILO-[0-9]{3}-C0[1-3]$/.test(s.conceptId ?? '') &&
  (s.conceptId ?? '').startsWith(`${s.storyId}-`) &&
  typeof s.title === 'string' &&
  s.title.trim().length > 0 &&
  typeof s.scriptText === 'string' &&
  s.scriptText.trim().length > 0 &&
  Number.isInteger(Number(s.wordCount)) &&
  Number(s.wordCount) > 0 &&
  Number(s.estimatedLengthMinutes) > 0 &&
  typeof s.theme === 'string' &&
  s.theme.trim().length > 0 &&
  typeof s.lesson === 'string' &&
  s.lesson.trim().length > 0 &&
  typeof s.canonReferences === 'string' &&
  s.canonReferences.trim().length > 0 &&
  s.approvalStatus === 'PENDING_REVIEW' &&
  String(s.approvalProcessedAt ?? '').trim() === '' &&
  Number(s.version) === 1 &&
  typeof s.createdAt === 'string' &&
  s.createdAt.length > 0 &&
  typeof s.updatedAt === 'string' &&
  s.updatedAt.length > 0;

return {
  json: {
    ...s,
    scriptRecordValid: valid
  }
};
